function.name: submit_plan
function.arguments: {"decision": "clarify", "reason": "请求同时指定了两个区域（ERCO 和 CISO），但 study_schema.region_id 只能取单一区域值，且不允许把一条请求拆成两个独立研究。缺失/歧义字段：(1) region_id —— 需明确是 ERCO 还是 CISO 作为单一研究区域，或说明如何将两区域合并为单一 region_id（当前 schema 不支持多区域）；(2) 其余字段可解析：horizon_minutes=60（一小时）、cost_shortfall=20.0、cost_reserve=1.0、task_type=upward_reserve_sizing、rolling_window 采用默认 train_days=730/cal_days=30/test_days=30/rolling_step_days=30。请确认单一区域后即可受理。", "study_schema": null, "admissible_variables": ["calendar", "cost_ratio", "current_load", "horizon", "lagged_load", "load_statistics", "observed_weather", "recent_ramp", "region_id"], "forbidden_variables": ["fabricated_result", "future_load", "future_weather", "raw_data_modification", "realized_target", "test_period_residual"], "workflow": [], "evidence_trace": [], "explanation": "该请求在区域维度上存在歧义：单一研究只能绑定一个 region_id，而请求要求 ERCO 与 CISO 同时参与且不得拆分为两个研究，因此无法在不违反 schema 的前提下确定 region_id。其余参数（任务类型 upward_reserve_sizing、horizon_minutes=60、cost_shortfall=20.0、cost_reserve=1.0、滚动窗口默认配置）均可解析。所有数值结果（备用容量、平均成本、覆盖率、置信区间、bootstrap 结论、调度结果）只能由经校验的数值工作流计算，本层不生成任何此类数值。请澄清单一区域后重新提交。", "audit_log": {"triggered_rules": ["clarification_required", "single_region_required", "no_request_splitting"], "human_approval_required": false}, "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only"}
